answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: (a) main(argv, env, seams) takes seams which/install/out/err, read at superclaude.py:164 and :376-392, so the proof injects them and needs no real claude, curl or powershell; (b) _install picks its fetcher from launch.runs_shell_scripts(), so replacing that and subprocess.run records either branch on any host; (c) the dry-run line 'a real launch would install it from <url>' is the existing output. To be measured at build; a tooth that reds on (a)-(c) opens a FIXME rather than a change outside the bounds.
answers.builder_check: A builder needs, and the ticket carries: the proof path, the four teeth in order (dry-run, real launch with default and overridden url, failed install exits 127, _install branches), the seam names, that superclaude.py is in bounds only if a tooth reds on it, and that the hollow check is to delete the install branch and read the proof red. Also that the ~/.local/bin lookup uses env['PATH'] put first by main().
answers.children: none, because it is one proof file; its parent is c3cd232ba0cf and e179281f6eff waits on it for the install tooth
answers.collision_check: No collision: ticket e179281f6eff's D4 retires test_superclaude_bare_box.py and named the install tooth dropped; this ticket is its replacement, so e179281f6eff's D4 is edited to point here. Ticket 1941e93b25a3 wrote the install code and its bounds do not forbid a later proof.
answers.falsifier_check: One clause per behavior: dry-run installs nothing; a real launch installs from the right url after looking in ~/.local/bin; a failed install exits 127; the real installer picks by the launch tool. Horizon: wrong if the proof reads green with the install branch of superclaude.py removed.
answers.gates_bound: code-seam: proved by the tester (PROVES keyed to the falsifier clauses, red-first, hollow run); feeds back to origin on failure.
answers.missing_check: Not in this ticket: any change to superclaude.py unless a tooth reds on it; the bash's retirement (e179281f6eff); a live network install (measured only through the seams, so the live installer URL is a hypothesis, labelled).
